description: Scripted MockLLMClient responses, consumed one per model call. Story: attempt 1 proposes a wrong fix (rolled back); attempt 2 first repeats it with different formatting (rejected by memory, re-prompted), then fixes the pricing bug (1 of 2 tests fixed -> kept as new baseline); attempt 3 fixes the discount bug -> green.

responses.analysis: subtotal() in src/pricing.js:3 ignores item.quantity, so multi-quantity carts are under-charged.
plan: Account for quantity when summing line items in subtotal()
Add the quantity to each line item total

responses.analysis: Adding quantity to price is wrong; a line total is price multiplied by quantity (src/pricing.js:3).
plan: Multiply price by quantity for each line item in subtotal()
